answer: PEP 505 (None-aware operators, 2015) proposed this; it was deferred, never decided. It came up again in PEP 824 (2026, Draft), whose rejected idea "Add ??= as AugAssign" cites it: "PEP 505 also suggested to add `??=` as an `AugAssign` node." https://peps.python.org/pep-0824/#add-as-augassign. Discussed on discuss.python.org: "Add None coalescing operator in Python" (2021, 57 posts, started by Kumar Aditya) https://discuss.python.org/t/8292. Discussed on discuss.python.org: "None-coalescing operator and null‑coalescing assignment" (2026, 66 posts, started by Li Mingxuan) https://discuss.python.org/t/107510; it refers to PEP 505 (Deferred).

args.idea: Has anyone proposed null coalescing in Python?

rows.title: None-aware operators
rows.quote: Several modern programming languages have so-called "`null`-coalescing" or "`null`- aware" operators, including C#, Dart, Perl, Swift, and PHP (starting in version 7). There are also stage 3 draft proposals for their addition to ECMAScript (a.k.a. JavaScript).

rows.quote: Just like in Javascript there is Nullish coalescing operator(??) for checking for null values, it would be a nice addition to python as python also has None .

MATCH (t:Thread {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Person)-[:STARTED]->(t) WITH t, s.name AS starter OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Person)-[e:POSTED_IN]->(t) WITH t, starter, a, e ORDER BY e.posts DESC WITH t, starter, collect({name: a.name, posts: e.posts, group: a.forum_group})[0..6] AS people OPTIONAL MATCH path = (t)-[r:DISCUSSES|MENTIONS]->(p:PEP) WITH t, starter, people, collect({pep: p.number, title: p.title, status: p.status, how: type(r)}) AS peps, collect(path) AS paths // Who started it and the committers who posted: drawn even when the thread names no PEP. OPTIONAL MATCH who = (a:Person)-[e:STARTED|POSTED_IN]->(t) WHERE type(e) = 'STARTED' OR a.forum_group = 'committers' RETURN t, starter, people, peps, paths, collect(who)[0..5]

MATCH (t:Thread {id: $id}) OPTIONAL MATCH (s:Person)-[:STARTED]->(t) WITH t, s.name AS starter OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Person)-[e:POSTED_IN]->(t) WITH t, starter, a, e ORDER BY e.posts DESC WITH t, starter, collect({name: a.name, posts: e.posts, group: a.forum_group})[0..6] AS people OPTIONAL MATCH path = (t)-[r:DISCUSSES|MENTIONS]->(p:PEP) WITH t, starter, people, collect({pep: p.number, title: p.title, status: p.status, how: type(r)}) AS peps, collect(path) AS paths // Who started it and the committers who posted: drawn even when the thread names no PEP. OPTIONAL MATCH who = (a:Person)-[e:STARTED|POSTED_IN]->(t) WHERE type(e) = 'STARTED' OR a.forum_group = 'committers' RETURN t, starter, people, peps, paths, collect(who)[0..5]

MATCH (p:PEP {number: $n}) OPTIONAL MATCH apath = (au:Person)-[:AUTHORED]->(p) WITH p, collect(DISTINCT au.name) AS authors, collect(apath)[0..4] AS apaths OPTIONAL MATCH ruling = (p)-[:RESOLVED_BY]->(d:Decision)-[m:MADE_BY]->(who) WITH p, authors, apaths, collect(ruling) AS rulings, collect({outcome: d.outcome, by: who.name, inferred: m.inferred, at: d.at, url: coalesce(d.verdict_url, d.url)}) AS decisions OPTIONAL MATCH line = (p)<-[:SUPERSEDES*1..5]-(:PEP) WITH p, authors, apaths, rulings, decisions, collect(line) AS lines OPTIONAL MATCH npath = (p)-[:HAS_SECTION]->(s:Section {kind: 'notice'}) WITH p, authors, apaths, rulings, decisions, lines, collect(npath) AS npaths, collect({text: s.text, url: s.url, title: s.title})[0] AS notice OPTIONAL MATCH back = (later:PEP)-[:REJECTS_APPROACH_OF*1..3]->(p) WHERE later <> p WITH p, authors, apaths, rulings, decisions, lines, npaths, notice, later, back, relationships(back)[0] AS x, nodes(back)[1] AS through RETURN p.number, p.title, p.status, p.created, p.url, coalesce(p.abstract, ''), authors, apaths, rulings, decisions, lines, npaths, notice, collect(back), collect({pep: later.number, title: later.title, status: later.status, created: later.created, via: x.via, through: through.number, hops: length(back)})
MATCH (a:Alternative)-[c:CITES]->(q:PEP) WHERE a.url IN $urls RETURN a.url, q.number, a.title, c.quote
MATCH e = (p:PEP {number: $n})-[x:REJECTS_APPROACH_OF]->(q:PEP) RETURN e, q.number, q.title, q.status, q.created, x.via[0] ORDER BY q.created
